import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_exact_50_free_shipping():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="widget", price_cents=5000, qty=1))
    expected = 0  # 5000 >= 5000 so free shipping
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == expected


def test_issue_just_below_50_charged():
    """Shipping is a flat $5.99 when the discounted subtotal is below $50.00."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="widget", price_cents=4999, qty=1))
    expected = 599  # 4999 < 5000 so flat 599
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == expected


def test_issue_just_above_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="widget", price_cents=5001, qty=1))
    expected = 0  # 5001 >= 5000 so free shipping
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == expected


def test_issue_quantities_sum_to_exact_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="widget", price_cents=2500, qty=2))
    expected = 0  # 2500*2=5000 >= 5000 so free shipping
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == expected


def test_issue_empty_cart_no_shipping():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    cart = Cart()
    expected = 0  # empty cart so 0
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == expected


def test_issue_percent_coupon_to_exact_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="widget", price_cents=5555, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    expected = 0  # floor(5555*10/100)=555, 5555-555=5000 >= 5000 so 0
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == expected


def test_issue_fixed_coupon_to_exact_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="widget", price_cents=5500, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    expected = 0  # 5500-500=5000 >= 5000 so 0
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == expected


def test_issue_discounted_below_charged_despite_subtotal_above():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="widget", price_cents=5500, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    expected = 599  # floor(5500*10/100)=550, 5500-550=4950 < 5000 so 599
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == expected


def test_contract_subtotal_sums_lines():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line in the cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="a", price_cents=1200, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="b", price_cents=300, qty=1))
    expected = 2700  # 1200*2+300*1=2700
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == expected


def test_contract_adding_same_sku_increases_qty():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="a", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="a", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    expected = 2  # 1+1=2
    assert cart.items[0].qty == expected


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="a", price_cents=3000, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):  # second coupon must raise CouponError
        cart.apply_coupon("TENOFF")


def test_contract_tax_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="a", price_cents=199, qty=1))
    expected = 16  # 199*8/100=15.92 rounds to 16
    assert cart.tax_cents() == expected


def test_contract_total_sums_discounted_shipping_tax():
    """total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax, and is never negative."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="a", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    expected = 1679  # 1000+599+80=1679 with tax 1000*8/100=80
    assert cart.total_cents() == expected
